items.guidance: Add a root Dockerfile based on an official Node image that copies package.json and package-lock.json, runs npm ci with production dependencies only, copies the source, and uses node index.js as the command. The app listens on PORT (the facts list 5006 as its port), so expose 5006 and let Deployz supply PORT at runtime. If index.js serves static assets or views through Express, copy those directories into the image.

In index.js, check whether an existing Express route already returns 2xx without database access, and report it if one exists. Otherwise register app.get('/health') returning 200 before other middleware and routes. Keep it independent of any database pool the app may configure.
